 Tune in to the Pokémon Night Out Livestream
 You don’t need to hit the town to have an incredible night out.
 Oct 21, 2026 
 The first Pokémon Night Out show is just days away! This exciting event will be held at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles on  October 24, 2026 , and The O2 in London on November 10, 2026 , uniting the eclectic world of Pokémon with high-energy electronic dance music (EDM) for a truly unforgettable evening.
 If you can’t make it in person but still want to dance the night away, tune in to our livestream on October 24 on the official Pokémon Twitch and YouTube channels! We’ll be coming to you live from the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles, bringing all the excitement of the event straight to your living room.
 Open media in a dialog window Photo credit: Lisa Chan 
 Photo credit: Lisa Chan Plus, to keep the vibes up during the show’s intermission, livestream viewers will be treated to a DJ set from electronic artist and multi-instrumentalist JVNA. This set is exclusive to the Pokémon Night Out livestream, promising themed visuals, sick beats, and some fun opportunities to participate during the performance.
 And if you watch the Twitch livestream for at least 30 minutes, you can earn an exclusive digital reward for your Pokémon GO avatar. Let everyone know that you joined in on all the Pokémon Night Out fun with this baseball jersey, which sports the Pokémon Night Out logo and Mewtwo striking a powerful pose atop a gorgeous gradient.
 Just visit our rewards site , connect your Pokémon Trainer Central account, link your Twitch account, and join the Pokémon Night Out party to earn this awesome reward.
 Whether you join us in person or from the comfort of your couch, you don’t want to miss this one-of-a-kind experience, Trainers. Although the London show won’t be livestreamed, tickets are still available! If you want to catch the excitement in person at The O2, visit the Pokémon Night Out website for more details.
